install_steps: curl -sLO https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/releases/latest/download/argo-linux-amd64.gz && gunzip argo-linux-amd64.gz && chmod +x argo-linux-amd64 && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && mv argo-linux-amd64 ~/.local/bin/argo
note: Also available via Homebrew (brew install argo) and Krew (kubectl krew install argo). For arm64 use argo-linux-arm64.gz. The CLI talks to the Argo Server via your kubeconfig; use argo auth token or ARGO_TOKEN for auth.
